name: Manage User Permissions
description: Guide to managing and updating user permissions and access levels

steps.title: Access Permissions Panel
steps.description: Navigate to the permissions management section from the main menu.

steps.title: Select User
steps.description: Choose the user whose permissions you want to modify from the user list.

steps.title: Update Permissions
steps.description: Check or uncheck the permission boxes to grant or revoke access to specific features.

steps.title: Save Changes
steps.description: Click the Save button to apply the permission changes.
